v4.9.068 - setups travel one by one, needs start fresh, and a retaken photo is noticed

#331 The whole setup palette travelled as ONE item, so two people each adding a
     setup while apart meant one list beat the other and one setup was simply
     gone. Every setup now has its own row, which also means deleting one still
     travels. The CREATE button's body existed twice and is now one function.
#332 The NEEDS defaults were handed out by reference and edited in place, so
     renaming a category changed the TEMPLATE for the rest of the session and
     the next new project opened holding the last project's categories - then
     pushed them up as though they had been typed there. Every new project now
     starts from the plain defaults, by decision.
#333 Change detection summarised a picture by its first 40 characters, which is
     about thirty bytes, and image formats spend their first thirty bytes on a
     fixed header - so two photos from the same camera looked identical.
     Retaking a shot offline could read as no change, never upload, and be
     replaced by the old one on the next pull. Drawings were judged on the
     NUMBER of strokes, so erasing one and drawing another was invisible.

Twelve tests now, including both devices making their own setup while apart.
